caption:
You got out. You keep going back. The door has been open the whole time — so why does the cell still feel like home? (Galatians 4:8-11 devotional)

Swapping old idols for a stricter rulebook only changes the object — the chain, the cell, and the cost stay exactly the same. But you didn't first grab God; "you are known by God," who opened the door before you ever asked, the ransom fully spent, not merely lent. Stop paying rent on a cell that's already empty; it's love, not fear of the price, that holds you now.
